# ⚠️ GENERATED DIRECTORY — DO NOT EDIT

Everything under `public/data/` is copied from `festivals/<festival-id>/` by `scripts/sync-data.mjs`. Direct edits here are silently overwritten on the next sync (which runs automatically on `npm run dev` and `npm run build`).

**To change festival data:** edit `festivals/<festival-id>/data/*.json` or `festivals/<festival-id>/config.json`, then run:

```bash
npm run lineup:sync
```
